name: Corridor features (parametric insertions)
source: Ported from the Road Furniture Designer plugin's feature definitions (same author, GPL): RDM 1.3 (2025) standard drawings RDM/1/3/3/01-03, S6.6, S12.5, S12.7, Table 12.7, Equation 12.1, S4.3.3. Values are defaults; every parameter is editable.
traffic_keeps_left_ref: Kenya drives on the left: traffic on the left of the chainage direction travels with it.

bus_bay.label: Bus bay
bus_bay.remark: Entry taper 30 m (25 m at 50 km/h or less), bay 25 m (more for more than one bus), exit taper 18 m, 4.0 m deep; flush kerb on the tapers, raised along the bay with 2 m ramped kerbs; 1.0 m platform. Bays serving opposite directions at least 60 m apart, centre to centre.

truck_bay.label: Truck parking bay / lay-by
truck_bay.remark: Entry taper 15 m, bay 70 m (varies), exit taper 10 m, straight tapers, 3.5 m deep; room for four to five heavy vehicles.

brake_check.label: Brake check area
brake_check.remark: Indicative: 100 m holds four to five semi-trailers, 60 m tapers, 3.5 m deep, at the top of a long steep descent.

climbing_lane.label: Climbing lane
climbing_lane.remark: 100 m tapers; full width to where trucks are back within 15 km/h of their level speed, at least 200 m past the crest; as wide as the adjacent through lane (width 0 = the same), which is reduced by 0.25 m where 3.25 m or more (RDM 1.3 6.6.3).

descending_lane.label: Descending lane
descending_lane.remark: Laid out as a climbing lane for the downhill traffic.

auxiliary_lane.label: Auxiliary / turning lane
auxiliary_lane.remark: 3.0 m wide (S4.3.3); storage and taper lengths from Tables 9.14-9.17 for the design speed and turning flow (set them here).

widening.label: Widening
widening.remark: A paved widening of the given width with tapers, for any purpose (passing place, access, school drop-off).

escape_ramp.label: Truck escape ramp
escape_ramp.remark: Departs tangentially on the downhill traffic's near side at a small angle; the road edge widens to the ramp over a 50 m taper; 30 m paved entry, then the arrester bed (length from Equation 12.1 for the runaway speed and the bed's rolling resistance, Table 12.7) and a last-chance mound.

ghost_island.label: Ghost-island widening (right-turn lane)
ghost_island.remark: Both edges move out by half the ghost island's width over the right-turn lane and the island, tapering back (lanes keep their width). Lengths indicative (RDM/1/3/2/01: 106 m approach taper); set them from the junction design.

junction_mouth.label: Junction mouth (side road)
junction_mouth.remark: The side drain stops across the mouth (a culvert carries it under the side road) and the corridor keeps its daylight; the side road itself is designed as its own alignment.

access.label: Private access
access.remark: At least 3 m wide with 6 m radii (the mouth here spans width + 2 radii); a traversable drainage pipe under the access where the side drain passes.
